name: Cloud-native platform
technical: Modern cloud-native, API-driven architecture that decouples the benefits core from delivery, versus legacy monoliths wrapped in rigid middleware.
prospect: Connects to the systems already in place rather than asking anyone to rip them out.

name: HRIS and payroll integrations
technical: Bi-directional integration with HRIS and payroll systems (Workday, ADP and others); Ben complements the HRIS rather than replacing it.
prospect: Sits alongside the HR system already in use and hands payroll figures it can trust.

name: Ben Smartcard
technical: A Mastercard issued per employee, carrying that employee's allowance directly.
prospect: One card per person, with their allowance already on it.

name: Point-of-sale policy rules
technical: Smart-card rules evaluate company policy at the point of sale, pre-approving or flagging a transaction as it happens.
prospect: The card already knows the policy, so spend is approved or stopped at the till instead of argued about later.

name: Auto-substantiation
technical: Card rules substantiate the majority of transactions automatically at point of sale, removing manual receipt collection.
prospect: Most purchases clear themselves, so people stop photographing receipts and nobody chases them.

name: Custom-branded Mastercards
technical: Enterprise-tier physical and virtual cards carrying the customer's own brand.
prospect: The card carries the employer's brand, not the vendor's.

name: Segmented allowances
technical: Budgets configurable by department, band, location, role and other attributes, managed centrally.
prospect: Different budgets for different teams, grades, countries or roles, all set in one place.

name: Complex eligibility processing
technical: Rules engine resolving interacting eligibility conditions, including changes triggered by location, grade or life events.
prospect: Rules that depend on other rules get worked out for you, including when someone changes country or grade mid-year.

name: One programme, local rules
technical: A single benefits programme operated across every country, with local statutory and tax rules built in, instead of one vendor and spreadsheet per country.
prospect: One benefits programme everywhere, that still obeys each country's own rules.

name: Real-time payroll reconciliation
technical: Continuous reconciliation of benefits data against payroll, surfacing discrepancies before the payroll run rather than after it.
prospect: Benefits and payroll are checked against each other as things change, so a mistake surfaces before payday rather than in next month's correction.

name: Inbound data validation
technical: Validation of inbound data at ingestion, flagging discrepancies before they propagate downstream.
prospect: Bad data gets caught on the way in, instead of being discovered three systems later.

name: Benefits design agent
technical: Specialised agent that drafts and models benefits design against actual utilisation data.
prospect: Next year's programme gets drafted against what people actually used this year.

name: Employee lifecycle agent
technical: Specialised agent handling joiners, movers and leavers, updating entitlements without manual intervention.
prospect: Joiners, movers and leavers have their entitlements updated without anyone keying it in twice.

name: Cost control agent
technical: Specialised agent monitoring spend against budget and surfacing drift.
prospect: Spend that is drifting gets raised while there is still a quarter left to do something about it.

name: AI helpdesk for employees
technical: Conversational assistant trained on that customer's own benefits documentation, answering employee queries directly.
prospect: People ask about their own benefits and get a real answer, instead of adding to the people team's inbox.

name: Guardrailed conversational search
technical: Conversational search constrained by preset question prompts to fix intent, guarantee security and structurally prevent hallucination on policy topics.
prospect: Answers about policy come from the employer's own documents and stay inside fixed bounds, so nothing gets invented about someone's cover.

name: Automated implementation and UAT
technical: Automated requirements gathering and UAT testing during implementation.
prospect: The build checks itself as it goes, so go-live is less of a leap of faith.

name: Private AI infrastructure
technical: All inference runs within Ben's AWS environment via Bedrock; customer and employee data is used only in a protected context and never retained in the models.
prospect: Everything runs inside a closed environment, and nobody's personal data ends up absorbed into a model.

name: Live spend and usage dashboards
technical: Real-time dashboards covering spend, utilisation and compliance.
prospect: What is being spent and what is actually being used, live, rather than stitched together from exports the week before a board meeting.

name: Utilisation reporting
technical: Per-benefit utilisation reporting against cost.
prospect: You can finally see which benefits earn their cost and which ones nobody has opened since January.

name: Benefits strategy consulting
technical: Advisory engagements from benefits health checks through to full programme transformation, alongside the software.
prospect: People who do this for a living work on the programme with you, not just hand over the software.

name: Pre-contract sandbox
technical: A working, configured test environment built before any contract is signed.
prospect: A working version of your own programme to try before anything is signed.

name: Dedicated Customer Success Manager
technical: Enterprise-tier named CSM and annual benefits design credits.
prospect: A named person who knows the account.

name: Security and compliance credentials
technical: ISO 27001:2022 certified, GDPR compliant, and registered as a UK financial-services supplier.
prospect: Certified to the standards a bank's procurement team asks about before it will even take a meeting.

name: SAML and Okta SSO
technical: Enterprise-tier SAML / Okta single sign-on.
prospect: Signs in through the identity provider already in use.

name: Broker channel
technical: A dedicated offering for benefits brokers alongside direct sales.
prospect: Available through a broker as well as direct.
